decision.rationale: Reproducible public-contract defect in the queue action: for {type:"queue", entries:2}, the loop repeatedly calls adjustSelected using the same stalePending snapshot, so each selected lane receives only one unit instead of two. For example, from initial state after select-even with unit=1, the observed pending vector becomes [0,1,0,1,0,1], while BG-D02-INV-QUEUE-ACCUMULATION requires [0,2,0,2,0,2]. The same undercount occurs for other valid units and nonzero starting pending values.
